## Root cause (reproduced locally)

`tests/test_audit_runner_core.py` inserts `PI_SKILLS_ROOT` (`/home/rgardler/.pi/agent/skills`, a symlink to `SorraAgents/skill`) into `sys.path`. That resolves the `audit.scripts.*` imports (the skills root contains the `audit` package) but **not** `skill.scripts.*`, which needs the *parent* of the `skill` package (`/home/rgardler/projects/SorraAgents`). Hence `from skill.scripts.failure_notice import FailureNotice` raises `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'skill.scripts'`.

Repro: `PYTHONPATH=/home/rgardler/.pi/agent/skills python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_audit_runner_core.py::TestGetClosingSentence::test_parses_with_wrapped_failure_notice`

Note the configured suite in `.pi/test-config.json` is vitest-only (`npm test -- tests/cli`, `tests/unit`), so this Python test is not part of the configured gate.
